title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E22 — Fortune Cookies; Seven-Minute Frosting; Roses
Begonias; fortune cookies; seven-minute frosting; cut roses.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E24 — City Bakery (Field Trip); Seat Cover
Making seat covers; painting tips; tart recipes.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E25 — Espresso; Planting Trees
Planting a tree; scissors; espresso.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E1 — Pickling Green Tomatoes; Grilled Pizza
Pickling; trellis; grilled pizza.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E2 — Rosine Green; Making a Bedp; Allied Down; Tulip Cutting
Allied down; tulip cutting; bed-making.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E3 — Teapot Shipping; Perennials; Lawn Aeration; Roasted Tomatoes
Dividing perennials; bakery; lawn aeration; roasted tomatoes; shipping teapots.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E8 — Pizza Dough
Make-ahead dough; creating crust for spinach and cheese pizza; sausage and pepper calzone; skillet pizza with wild mushrooms.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E12 — French Meringue
Pavlovas with an orange curd filling; chocolate dacquoise cake layered with chocolate ganache and coffee buttercream; tinted-pink angel food cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E13 — Press-in Crusts
Cheesecake with apricot finish; chocolate cream tart; Atlantic Beach tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S11 E12 — Pantry Milks
Dairy trade secrets; using pantry milk in passion fruit meringue pie and cuatro leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E2 — Pate Brisee
Flaky pâte brisée crust; mile-high apple pie; tomato tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E11 — Yeast Dough
Yeast dough treats include pecan sticky buns and pull-apart monkey bread.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E7 — A Classic French Dish: Pot Au Feu
Martha prepares pot-au-feu, a hearty French dish of root vegetables and various cuts of meat, all braised in a savory broth; it's served with sliced meat, vegetables and delicious accompaniments!

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Chicken Dinner
Martha serves up a delicious chicken dinner with fresh ingredients from her greenhouse; joined by her good friend Kevin Sharkey, they celebrate the perfect meal for a taste of home-cooked goodness.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E3 — Pizza Perfection: Sicilian and Neapolitan-Style Pizzas
Martha serves up delicious homemade pizzas alongside friends and pizza chefs Christian Petroni and Dean Medico; featuring classic pizzas, signature sauces, and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E6 — How to Make Croissants and Sourdough Bread
Martha journeys through her local area in search of the ultimate fresh-baked croissants and sourdough bread; learning about homemade bread and pastries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E8 — Martha Throws a Tea Party
Martha and her niece Sophie visit their favorite tea shop, Arogya, in Westport, Conn., to discover the dos and don'ts of making tea; they return to Martha's kitchen to create dishes with tea.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E8 — The Grind
Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E9 — Cooking With Wine
Beef bourguignon; cioppino, a tomato and wine-based fish stew; chicken Marsala; poached pears in red or white wine.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E10 — Italian Favorites
Eight-layer pork ragù; béchamel-filled lasagna baked in ramekins; chicken Parmesan; raviolo with an egg yolk and ricotta-spinach filling; linguine with clam sauce.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E11 — On the Bone
Oxtail; slow-roasted beef ribs; cowboy steak; Korean short rib kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E12 — Cheese
Cheese fondue; fettuccine Alfredo; melting raclette; grown-up grilled cheese.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E6 — Rice
Fluffy white rice; pilaf; risotto; Thai fried rice.
